column1: # Sign codes as used in the transcriptions. Key frozen 2 Nov 2026 from c. 23r against c. 22, before c. 13r was transcribed.
# Simple substitution: 20 signs for the 20 letters a b c d e f g h i l m n o p q r s t u/v z. No nulls, no homophones, no code groups.
# The key came from a later clear copy, c. 22, aligned with the cipher of c. 23r. It was not got by cryptanalysis.
# Balls and dots on strokes do not change the value. Hand variants across the letters are noted per sign.
# Hands: a can be written closed like D, and c open like A; n and h (V, v) and tailed t and g are close; the shape is then settled by sense, marked in the reading.
# cc. 73-74 (1636, same key): a small caret above a sign doubles the letter.
